visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An anthropomorphic bulldog with an extremely muscular, human-like torso is seen riding a red motorized tricycle through a sunlit, narrow urban street. He is wearing a white ribbed tank top, green athletic shorts with white stripes, and a beige bucket hat. The tricycle is heavily loaded with cleaning supplies, including several large brown feather dusters and various long mop handles. The background features traditional Asian-style architecture with shop signs written in Traditional Chinese, creating a dense metropolitan atmosphere. (2) The scene abruptly cuts to a spacious, modern indoor living room with a bright and airy feel. A second anthropomorphic bulldog, styled as a housewife in a pink floral dress and purple hair rollers, is aggressively chasing the first bulldog. She swings a brown feather duster at him while he ducks and runs in a frantic, comedic manner. The room is furnished with a large tan sectional sofa and a dark TV stand, with a view of an urban skyline visible through a large glass window in the background.
